findings.title: Quotation contains arithmetic errors
findings.explanation: Totals do not add up in: quotation_D09_lumen-lighting-solutions-ltd.pdf. The supplier must correct them before the quotation can be used.

evidence.quote: Quotations that contain arithmetic errors must be corrected by the supplier before they can be used.

findings.title: Quotation valid for less than 30 days
findings.explanation: quotation_D09_lumen-lighting-solutions-ltd.pdf: valid until 2026-04-05, 18 days after the request date 2026-03-18

evidence.quote: Quotations must remain valid for at least 30 days from the date of the purchase request.

findings.title: Advance payment above 30 percent
findings.explanation: quotation (proposed terms) quotation_D09_lumen-lighting-solutions-ltd.pdf asks for 50% in advance; the limit is 30 percent.

evidence.quote: Advance payments must not exceed 30 percent of the contract value.

findings.title: Business justification present

ref.value: Replacement of end-of-life equipment used by the finance team.

findings.title: Supplier name matches a quotation
findings.explanation: 'Lumen Lighting Solutions Ltd.' matches an attached quotation.

findings.title: Amount rules need a USD total
findings.explanation: The request is in EGP. The policy states limits in USD and converts at the treasury rate on the request date; no exchange-rate source is configured, so amount-based rules were not evaluated.

evidence.quote: All amounts in this policy are expressed in USD; purchases in other currencies are converted using the treasury rate on the request date.
